title: Concept: Insecure temporary file via tempfile.mktemp (python) — review required
description: In python, tempfile.mktemp names temporary files predictably or separates name choice from creation, opening a race window. The remedy is atomic exclusive creation via tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile.
applicability: python codebases creating temporary files through tempfile.mktemp; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Local file overwrite or disclosure via symlink races; LOW severity, higher on multi-user systems.
